changelog: [When to Segment] — added positive, preference-based guidance to prefer boundaries after completed correlative structures, after main lexical verbs (not between auxiliaries and lexical verbs), and after verb complements/appositives/locatives that disambiguate predicate sense. This addresses placement errors where heads or complements were separated from context.

[Decision Procedure] — in the RANKING step, added explicit instruction to demote (lower confidence) candidate boundaries that would split auxiliary+lexical-verb chains, separate verbs from their disambiguating objects/complements/appositives/locatives, break correlative constructions before the second conjunct/head is visible, or separate predicates from scope-establishing prepositional phrases. Keeps these as candidates but ranks them low to avoid premature commitment.
